content: अविषय {%a.%} .²1 Unperceived, invisible, beyond the reach of the senses. .²2 Insensible. .²3 Disregarding objects of sense; ˚मनसां यतीनाम् <ls>M. 1. 1</ls>. .{@-यः@} .²1 Absence, disappearance; रवेरविषये किं न प्रदीपस्य प्रकाशनम् <ls>H. 2. 78</ls>. .²2 Not an object of (anything), not within the reach of, beyond, transcending; न कश्चिद्धीमतामविषयो नाम <ls>Ś. 4</ls>; सकलवचनानामविषयः <ls>Māl. 1. 30</ls> beyond the reach (power) of words; सौमित्रेरपि पत्त्रिणामविषये तत्र प्रिये क्वासि मे <ls>U. 3. 45</ls>. .²3 Disregard of the objects of sense.
